# SopKit — Detailed capabilities index

> SopKit is a privacy-first web utility platform. Most utilities (image processing, PDF manipulation, developer converters, formatting, and calculators) run client-side inside the user's browser sandbox using standard Web APIs, Canvas, and WebAssembly. No user files are saved to remote databases.

Canonical Base URL: https://sopkit.space
LLMs Index: https://sopkit.space/llms.txt
Agent Policy: https://sopkit.space/ai.txt

## Core Architecture & Security Model

- **Browser-First sandboxed execution**: Utilizes client-side WebAssembly, Canvas, and DOM APIs where applicable. Files remain in local browser memory.
- **Transparent processing notices**: Every tool explicitly discloses its execution model (client-side vs external service) in visible page badges, structured data, and headers.
- **Zero account requirement**: Core utilities operate without login, registration, or tracking cookies.

### Health & Fitness Tools

#### [BMR Calculator (Basal Metabolic Rate)](https://sopkit.space/bmr-calculator)
- **Description**: Compare two equations for basal metabolic rate: Mifflin-St Jeor and revised Harris-Benedict, each returning kcal/day from weight, height, age and sex.

#### [TDEE Calculator](https://sopkit.space/tdee-calculator)
- **Description**: Calculate your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) based on your activity level and fitness goals.

#### [Macro Calculator](https://sopkit.space/macro-calculator)
- **Description**: Calculate your ideal macronutrient ratio (protein, carbs, fats) for weight loss, gain, or maintenance.

#### [Ideal Body Weight Calculator](https://sopkit.space/ideal-body-weight-calculator)
- **Description**: Determine your healthy weight range based on your height, age, and gender using standard formulas.

#### [Body Fat Percentage Calculator](https://sopkit.space/body-fat-calculator)
- **Description**: Estimate your body fat percentage using US Navy or BMI methods for a clearer picture of your fitness.


### Privacy & Security Tools Tools

#### [PII Scrubber](https://sopkit.space/pii-scrubber)

#### [Email Validator](https://sopkit.space/email-validator)

### Extraction Tools Tools

#### [URL Extractor](https://sopkit.space/url-extractor)
- **Description**: Harvest every link from pasted text, Markdown, HTML or logs, normalise bare domains, flag invalid entries, remove duplicates and export the list.

#### [Email Extractor](https://sopkit.space/email-extractor)
- **Description**: Extract email addresses from pasted text, contact lists, HTML, Markdown, and documents. Normalize, deduplicate, group by domain, and export clean results locally.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/email-extractor.md

#### [Phone Number Extractor](https://sopkit.space/phone-number-extractor)
- **Description**: Extract phone-number-like sequences from notes, logs, contact lists, and copied text. Preserve source formatting while reporting digit counts and exporting results.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/phone-number-extractor.md

#### [IP Address Extractor](https://sopkit.space/ip-address-extractor)
- **Description**: Extract IPv4 and IPv6 addresses from server logs, headers, diagnostics, and text. Classify matches and export a compact network inventory locally.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/ip-address-extractor.md

#### [Domain Extractor](https://sopkit.space/domain-extractor)
- **Description**: Extract hostnames from URLs and email addresses, remove common www prefixes, deduplicate domains, sort them, and export a clean domain inventory.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/domain-extractor.md

#### [HTML Link Extractor](https://sopkit.space/html-link-extractor)
- **Description**: Parse raw HTML and extract anchor URLs, visible text, rel attributes, target values, and optionally resolved relative links using a base URL.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/html-link-extractor.md

#### [HTML Image Extractor](https://sopkit.space/html-image-extractor)
- **Description**: Extract image URLs from HTML img tags, srcset, picture sources, Open Graph image tags, and Twitter image metadata for audits and research.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/html-image-extractor.md

#### [HTML Metadata Extractor](https://sopkit.space/html-meta-extractor)
- **Description**: Inspect HTML title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter cards, favicon, language, theme color, and heading content in a structured list.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/html-meta-extractor.md

#### [JSONPath Extractor](https://sopkit.space/json-path-extractor)
- **Description**: Query nested JSON with property selectors, array indexes, wildcards, recursive descent, unions, slices, and simple comparison filters. Copy matching values and paths.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/json-path-extractor.md

#### [Regex Extractor](https://sopkit.space/regex-extractor)
- **Description**: Run custom regular expressions against text, inspect capture groups and character positions, use common extraction presets, and export structured matches.
- **Markdown Representation**: https://sopkit.space/tool-markdown/regex-extractor.md

#### [CSV Column Extractor](https://sopkit.space/csv-column-extractor)
